content.title: Djo Confirms Summer 2026 Headline Tour Dates
content.text: Play JamBase Games: ‘Name That Artist’ 🤔 Advertisement Djo Confirms Summer 2026 Headline Tour DatesPond will support the newly announced shows. By Andy Kahn Mar 17, 2026 • 8:14 am PDT Photo by Piers Greenan Share This Actor/musician Joe Keery’s music project Djo confirmed a batch of headlining 2026 Tour dates. Pond will support the five newly added shows set for July. The headlining concerts fall among previously announced Djo performances supporting Tame Impala on tour this summer. Djo booked a headlining show on July 14 at Stage AE in Pittsburgh, which will be followed by joining Tame Impala in Philadelphia on July 15. Djo will perform with Pond at Forest Hills Stadium in New York City on July 17. Additional headlining dates were added on July 21 at Thompson’s Point in Portland, Maine and on July 23 at Artpark Amphitheater in Lewiston, New York. Djo and Pond will also perform on July 31 at Allianz Amphitheater in Richmond, Virginia. Tickets to Djo’s headlining shows with Pond go on sale on Friday, March 20 at 10 a.m. local venue time.
